source_text: Other alternatives for 5-bp steps such as a spring-loaded mechanism (Appleby et al., 2011) are also implausible. Such a mechanism would require several hidden kinetic steps to occur per observed 5-bp step (i.e., 'loading of the spring'), resulting in a non-exponential dwell time distribution (Myong et al., 2005), inconsistent with our data
